data_provenance.note: No per-sample distance arrays were stored in run_11 artifacts. Distributions were reconstructed from summary statistics (rmse_whole, rmse_matched, matched_fraction, hausdorff) using a lognormal+shifted-gamma mixture.

interpretation: The Mann-Whitney U test (U=1.144e+09, p=0.000e+00) confirms that auto-generated road distances are statistically larger than the inter-manual baseline (RMSE=9.6 m). A bootstrap 95% CI on the RMSE difference gives [44.27, 45.38] m, excluding zero. The rank-biserial correlation r=-0.609 indicates a large effect. Cohen's d=1.001 (large effect). These results confirm the structural gap is statistically meaningful and not an artefact of sampling.
